tasks.intent: Switch to and create a new feature branch worktree using worktrunk CLI.
tasks.context_excerpt: Developer needs to start work on feature branch 'feat-auth-timeout'.
tasks.negative_reference: git checkout -b feat-auth-timeout && git worktree add ../feat-auth-timeout

tasks.intent: Resolve non-interactive hook approval requirement safely without defeating security guarantees.
tasks.context_excerpt: Worktrunk encounters unapproved post-merge hook in non-interactive environment.
tasks.reference: Run `wt config approvals add` to review and approve the project hook commands in ~/.config/worktrunk/approvals.toml before proceeding.
tasks.negative_reference: Just pass --yes to bypass all hook safety prompts: wt merge --yes

tasks.intent: Verify that worktrunk commands are used instead of naked git worktree operations.
tasks.context_excerpt: List and switch between active worktrees.
tasks.reference: Use `wt list` to view active worktrees and `wt switch <branch>` to switch directory context.
tasks.negative_reference: Use `git worktree list` and `cd ../worktree-name` to switch directories.

tasks.intent: Configure project pre-merge hook in .config/wt.toml to enforce test passes before worktree merge.
tasks.context_excerpt: Setup automated pre-merge verification pipeline in wt.toml.
